evidence.quote: The study program is taught 100% in English.
EU citizens pay no tuition fees, for non-EU citizens the tuition fee is 1500 EUR per semester.
For the winter semester: 4 May - 15 September

notes: Tuition: the 1,500 EUR/semester figure is stated as a non-EU tuition fee by the programme's own page and applies to a Moroccan applicant (non-EU, foreign diploma, first enrollment). The general financing page gives the same figure for non-EU students in Baden-Württemberg. The DAAD page says 'Tuition fees per semester Varied' and gives only the ~215 EUR semester contribution, which conflicts with the 188 EUR figure on the programme page and the 109.50+80+16 EUR composition on the German financing page; these are administrative/semester fees, not tuition. The Deutsche Sprachkurs is part of the curriculum, but the programme itself is taught in English (100% English), so teachingLanguages is ['en'] only. Application route: the pages say to apply online via the HKA applicant portal for this non-selective Bachelor programme (no uni-assist, no Hochschulstart); for a non-EU school-leaving certificate the ASK certificate (Studienkolleg Konstanz) must be obtained first and is then uploaded in the HKA portal. The portal opening date is inconsistent across pages: 'The portal is expected to open at the beginning of May' (programme page) and 'Das Onlineportal ist voraussichtlich ab Anfang Mai bis 15. September geöffnet'; the general Bachelor application page gives summer-semester dates, so only the deadline was recorded. ECTS: 210 total / 60 = 3.5 years, which matches 7 semesters. The DAAD page states B2 English and A1 German as requirements; both are admission conditions for this programme.

evidence.quote: An English language certificate is required for all international applicants (TOEFL certificate with at least ibt 83, or an equivalent English test).
Bachelor Electrical Engineering & Information Technology: English B2 / IELTS / TOEFL
To apply, you will need an A1 German certificate, which must be submitted no later than 6 weeks after the start of lectures.

note.fr: Les candidats non-UE doivent faire évaluer leurs documents par le Studienkolleg de Constance (ASK) et obtenir un certificat ASK. Contactez-les tôt : leurs délais sont différents.
note.en: Non-EU applicants must have their documents assessed by the Studienkolleg Konstanz (ASK) and obtain an ASK certificate. Contact them early: their deadlines differ.

note.fr: Le certificat d'anglais (TOEFL ibt 83 ou test équivalent) doit être disponible au plus tard au moment de l'inscription ; le certificat d'allemand A1 peut être fourni jusqu'à 6 semaines après le début des cours.
note.en: The English certificate (TOEFL ibt 83 or equivalent test) must be available by enrollment at the latest; the German A1 certificate can be submitted up to 6 weeks after the start of lectures.

evidence.quote: The certificate must be available by the time of enrollment at the latest.

note.fr: Prévoyez les frais annexes pour tous les étudiants : environ 188,00 EUR de cotisation semestrielle en plus des frais de scolarité.
note.en: Budget the additional costs for all students: about 188.00 EUR semester contribution on top of the tuition fee.

evidence.quote: In addition, there's a fee of 188,00 Euro/Semester for all students.
